prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='THETA', seasonality_champion='rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: THETA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) matching y_true's upward trend in both folds, while rf dominates seasonality capture (0.4956 correlation) and overall RMSE (304.43). The extreme RMSE spread (14.73) and unstable rankings (Kendall τ=0.24) indicate high model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to exploit the split between trend and seasonality champions while handling concept drift.
